decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ PATH{ NAME "client" }, SETTINGS{ NAME "delivery_compact" VALUE u8=1 } } — an older consumer's compaction opt-in. The key is RETIRED (RFC-0032 §6.2): a receiver ignores it, the absent delivery_policy reads as all-zero, and the subscription is served with ordinary chain FWD{WRITE} deliveries
decoded.note: no reader surfaces a compaction opt-in; a :subscribers[N] read returns the record with the retired key as written
